formDescription: Verifies identity and employment authorization for individuals hired for employment in the United States.

questions.text: What is your last name (family name)?
questions.explanation: Enter your legal last name as it appears on official documents.

questions.text: What is your first name (given name)?
questions.explanation: Enter your legal first name as it appears on official documents.

questions.text: What is your middle initial?
questions.explanation: Enter your middle initial if you have one. Leave blank if not applicable.

questions.text: Have you used any other last names?
questions.explanation: Choose Yes if you have used any other last names, such as a maiden name or previous legal name.

questions.text: What other last names have you used?
questions.explanation: Enter any other last names you have used, such as a maiden name or previous legal name.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Other last names used by the user

questions.text: What is your home address?
questions.explanation: Enter your current home address, including street, apartment number (if any), city, state, and ZIP code.

questions.text: What is your date of birth?
questions.explanation: Enter your date of birth in the format mm/dd/yyyy.

questions.text: What is your U.S. Social Security number?
questions.explanation: Enter your nine-digit U.S. Social Security number.

questions.text: What is your email address?
questions.explanation: Enter your current email address.

questions.text: What is your telephone number?
questions.explanation: Enter your current telephone number, including area code.

questions.text: Please select your citizenship or immigration status
questions.explanation: Select the option that best describes your current citizenship or immigration status. Only one option may be selected.

options.label: A citizen of the United States
options.value: A citizen of the United States

options.label: A noncitizen national of the United States
options.value: A noncitizen national of the United States

questions.text: If you are a lawful permanent resident, what is your USCIS or A-Number?
questions.explanation: Enter your USCIS number or A-Number if you selected 'A lawful permanent resident' as your status.

questions.text: If you are an alien authorized to work, what is your expiration date (if any)?
questions.explanation: Enter the expiration date of your work authorization if you selected 'An alien authorized to work.' Leave blank if not applicable.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Expiration date of user's work authorization

questions.text: If you are an alien authorized to work, provide one of the following numbers
questions.explanation: Enter your USCIS A-Number, Form I-94 Admission Number, or Foreign Passport Number and Country of Issuance if you selected 'An alien authorized to work.'

textboxes.label: Foreign Passport Number and Country of Issuance

autopopulate.profileDescription: User's foreign passport number and country of issuance

questions.text: Please sign to certify the information above is correct
questions.explanation: Sign your name to certify that the information you provided is true and correct.

questions.text: What is the date of the employee's signature?
questions.explanation: This field will be automatically filled with today's date.

questions.text: What List A identity and employment authorization document(s) are you presenting?
questions.explanation: List A documents establish both identity and employment authorization (for example a U.S. passport or permanent resident card). Enter the document title, issuing authority, number, and expiration for each document you present. Leave unused rows blank.

questions.text: What List B identity document are you presenting?
questions.explanation: List B documents establish identity only (for example a driver's license). Enter the document title, issuing authority, number, and expiration. Use List B together with a List C document when you are not presenting a List A document.

questions.text: What List C employment authorization document are you presenting?
questions.explanation: List C documents establish employment authorization only (for example a Social Security card). Enter the document title, issuing authority, number, and expiration. Use List C together with a List B document when you are not presenting a List A document.

questions.text: Is there any additional information the employer should record about the documents examined?
questions.explanation: Use this for notes the employer needs to keep with Section 2, such as additional document details or clarifications. Leave blank if none.

questions.text: Did you use an alternative procedure authorized by DHS to examine documents?
questions.explanation: Check this box if you used an alternative procedure authorized by the Department of Homeland Security to examine documents.

questions.text: What is the employee's first day of employment?
questions.explanation: Enter the employee's first day of employment in the format mm/dd/yyyy.

questions.text: What is the name and title of the employer or authorized representative?
questions.explanation: Enter the last name, first name, and title of the employer or authorized representative completing this section.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Last Name, First Name and Title of Employer or Authorized Representative

questions.text: Signature of employer or authorized representative
questions.explanation: Sign to certify that you have reviewed the employee's documents and completed this section.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

questions.text: What is the date of the employer's signature?
questions.explanation: This field will be automatically filled with today's date.

questions.text: What is the business or organization name?
questions.explanation: Enter the full name of the employer's business or organization.

questions.text: What is the business or organization address?
questions.explanation: Enter the complete address, including city, state, and ZIP code, of the employer's business or organization.

autopopulate.profileDescription: Business or Organization Address, City or Town, State, ZIP Code

questions.text: Did a preparer or translator assist you in completing Section 1?
questions.explanation: Choose Yes if someone helped you complete Section 1. If Yes, provide their information below.

questions.text: What is the employee's name as shown in Section 1 for the preparer or translator certification?
questions.explanation: Provide the employee's last name, first name, and middle initial as shown in Section 1.

questions.text: Who helped prepare or translate Section 1 for the employee?
questions.explanation: If a preparer and/or translator assisted with Section 1, enter their name, address, and signature information. You may record up to four preparers or translators. Skip this if the employee completed Section 1 alone.

questions.text: What is the first preparer or translator's information?
questions.explanation: Enter the name, address, and signature for the first preparer or translator.

questions.text: What is the second preparer or translator's information?
questions.explanation: Enter the name, address, and signature for the second preparer or translator, if applicable.

questions.text: What is the third preparer or translator's information?
questions.explanation: Enter the name, address, and signature for the third preparer or translator, if applicable.

questions.text: What is the fourth preparer or translator's information?
questions.explanation: Enter the name, address, and signature for the fourth preparer or translator, if applicable.

questions.text: What is the employee's name as shown in Section 1 for Supplement B?
questions.explanation: Provide the employee's last name, first name, and middle initial as shown in Section 1.

questions.text: What are the details for the first reverification or rehire?
questions.explanation: Complete this section if the employee is being rehired or requires reverification. Enter the date of rehire, new name (if applicable), and document information.

textboxes.label: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

textboxes.label: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

questions.text: For the first Supplement B entry, did you use an alternative procedure authorized by DHS?
questions.explanation: Check this box if you used an alternative procedure authorized by the Department of Homeland Security to examine documents for this reverification or rehire.

questions.text: What are the details for the second reverification or rehire?
questions.explanation: Complete this section if the employee is being rehired or requires reverification. Enter the date of rehire, new name (if applicable), and document information.

textboxes.label: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

textboxes.label: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

questions.text: For the second Supplement B entry, did you use an alternative procedure authorized by DHS?
questions.explanation: Check this box if you used an alternative procedure authorized by the Department of Homeland Security to examine documents for this reverification or rehire.

questions.text: What are the details for the third reverification or rehire?
questions.explanation: Complete this section if the employee is being rehired or requires reverification. Enter the date of rehire, new name (if applicable), and document information.

textboxes.label: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Name of Employer or Authorized Representative

textboxes.label: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

autopopulate.profileDescription: Signature of Employer or Authorized Representative

questions.text: For the third Supplement B entry, did you use an alternative procedure authorized by DHS?
questions.explanation: Check this box if you used an alternative procedure authorized by the Department of Homeland Security to examine documents for this reverification or rehire.
